Documented Params Contract Gate
================================

This document exists solely to be compiled by
``tests/test_documented_params_contract_gate.py`` (SC#3, D-K). Its toctree
below makes all three ``toctree_*`` keys live, and ``conf.py``'s
``typst_elements`` makes ``papersize``/``fontsize`` live too, so every one
of the nine published parameters
(``docs/source/user_guide/templates.rst`` "Standard Parameters") is
genuinely exercised by this single build.
